dither_counterfactual.description: Mechanism diagnostic only: one stochastic-Q4 error realization reused at all 16 depths versus independent stochastic realizations of the same FP32 shared block at each invocation.
dither_counterfactual.interpretation: Small and sign-unstable; does not establish correlation as the main mechanism.

row_distribution.interpretation: Shared block rows are materially harder for one-scale-per-row Q4; finer scale locality is better supported than dither.
